title: Block Edit in Excel for pages based on the User table
summary: Edit in Excel now blocks page-based editing for tables that are the User table to prevent authentication corruption when users are edited via Excel and published back. A new check in the Edit in Excel implementation logs telemetry and raises an error before workbook generation.
key_points: Adds CheckPageIsSupported validation in codeunit 1482 to block User table pages
Check runs at all entry points before workbook creation and web service setup
Uses source table identification to cover all User-based pages including renamed or localized ones
Logs telemetry event 0000U9E when block occurs
New tests verify the blocking behavior for pages with User as source table
